mapper.select: SELECT ics20_revision_history_id AS revision_history_id, ics20_reg_date AS reg_date, ics20_submission_date AS submission_date, ics20_effect_date AS effect_date, ics20_title AS title, f_cdnm('FinanceAgencyCode', ics20_finance_agency_cd, 0, ics20_reg_date) AS finance_agency_name, ics20_reflection_date AS reflection_date, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = ics20_revision_history_id ) AS file_count, ics20_note AS note FROM ics20_revision_history INNER JOIN ics19_revision_relate_ics ON ics19_revision_history_id = ics20_revision_history_id WHERE ics19_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} ORDER BY ics20_reg_date DESC
